translation_snapshot.source: Target is being assailed by an automated saw blade that cuts its flesh for %0.2f physical damage each turn%s. When the effect expires, the saw will explode for %0.2f fire damage and fly back to its source, pulling the target with it (up to %d tiles).
translation_snapshot.target: 目标受到飞锯切割，每回合受到 %0.2f 物理伤害%s。持续时间自然结束时，若施加者仍在场，飞锯会爆炸，造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害并飞回施加者，将目标拉回最多 %d 格；免疫击退时不会被拉动。
